Deep_Chest_Cursorial_Chassis.description: A steeply angled, deep-chested ribcage housing massively expanded lungs and a disproportionately large heart. Rather than explosive bursts of speed, this chassis is forged to endlessly run down fleeing prey until they collapse from sheer exhaustion.

Low_Slung_Vulpes_Core.description: A significantly lighter, elongated, and highly flexible spine allowing for profound agility and a lower center of gravity. It is perfectly adapted for rapid, twisting directional changes in dense underbrush and executing high-trajectory mousing leaps.
